accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
Quality Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, Database Engineering, and Reliability Engineering are active with distinct ownership boundaries.

Reliability Engineering owns live-service reliability: service-health objectives, observability strategy, actionable alerting, production incident response/mitigation, recovery verification, and post-incident learning.

Reliability Engineering does not absorb application implementation, release promotion authority, independent QA, security policy, Cloudflare/provider semantics, database-engine semantics, or agent-harness design.
Release success, provider health, alert clearance, telemetry normalization, and user-visible recovery are separate evidence layers; completion claims must not collapse them.
Telemetry volume is not an objective. Metrics, logs, traces, profiles/events, synthetics, and provider-native signals are selected to answer operational questions.
Actionable symptom/user-impact alerts are preferred over noisy internal threshold paging; internal alerts remain justified when they predict imminent impact or enable a concrete action.

Active incidents prioritize safe impact reduction and truthful partial-state tracking over perfect root-cause explanation; rollback is a production action and does not imply data-side-effect reversal.
Post-incident analysis should improve detection, mitigation, architecture, coordination, runbooks, or regression safeguards rather than reduce complex failures to a single human cause.
Sentry/OpenTelemetry/provider dashboards are execution/reference surfaces and do not create mutation authority or become the Reliability Engineering identity.
Provider/version-specific observability APIs, query syntax, retention, pricing, sampling defaults, alert semantics, and feature status require current authoritative documentation when material.
Mobile Flutter/Android remains an approved progressive reference pack rather than a top-level faculty.

The next capability audit is Infrastructure/IaC and remains reference-first until a distinct ownership layer beyond Software Development, Release Engineering, Security Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, and Reliability Engineering is proven.
unresolved_risks: Reliability Engineering promotion is architecture- and contract-supported, but measurable DEDAL-specific outcome gains still require representative ordinary production work.
Small/local systems can be overburdened by formal SLO/on-call ceremony; process must scale to actual risk and operating model.
Telemetry can be incomplete, sampled, delayed, or provider-specific; production claims must remain scoped to evidence quality.
Incident mitigation can itself cause side effects; authority and recovery semantics remain mandatory.
The new faculty may be over-routed onto ordinary debugging unless the task is genuinely about live service health or operational reliability.

next_executable_step.action: Deep-audit high-signal Infrastructure-as-Code and infrastructure lifecycle guidance, including the pinned HashiCorp agent-skill corpus. Determine whether provisioning/state/plan/apply/drift/infrastructure lifecycle is a distinct recurring owner or should remain progressive reference knowledge under Software Development, Release Engineering, Security Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, and Reliability Engineering.
